name: md-frontend-retirement
body: Reconciliation record for retiring `solution.container.md-frontend` [autonomous]. Source: SPEC.md §5, §6. `solution.container.md-frontend` is removed and `solution.container.structural-scanner` takes its place. The system containment edge moves: `contains solution.system.apg → solution.container.structural-scanner` replaces `… → solution.container.md-frontend`. The two `realised-by` edges that pointed at md-frontend — from `domain.entity.engine-pin` and `domain.entity.frontend-artifact` — are intentionally NOT re-pointed to the structural scanner: the brief says "Markdown is no longer a separate frontend artifact", and the structural scanner has no language-version ceiling, so it is not an `engine-pin` subject and is deliberately not a per-language `frontend-artifact`. Those two entities keep their seven remaining container targets and their bodies are amended to say so; the bundled scanner is modelled instead by `domain.entity.structural-scanner`, which realises `solution.container.structural-scanner`. The Markdown frontend's code is absorbed, not deleted — the retired frontend's `md` stream and anchors are now served by `src/structlib` (`rust.structfrontend.md`), whose Markdown parser/emitters sit under `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` / `solution.component.structural-format-emitters`. `rust.mdfrontend` and its emitters no longer exist as code and no longer resolve as graph nodes (0 nodes match `rust.mdfrontend`; `rust.structfrontend.md` resolves). This note was reconciled in pass `global.note.durable-spec-prose-reconcile-0-17`, which carries a `details` edge to it and corrected the former present-tense claim that `rust.mdfrontend` was a real anchor.
